title: Staged zipper deployment and progressive split for Hosted API upgrade pipeline
creator: Maya Chen
description: Goal: replace brittle global blue/green swaps with a deterministic, idempotent 'zipper' rollout that supports LTS pinning, regional sequencing, and progressive traffic split with measurement-based gates. This ticket covers orchestration changes to the hosted API pipeline, upgrade tooling, and rollout policy config so we can do zero-surprise regional upgrades while meeting SLOs and enabling fast rollback. The zipper approach stages a live cutover by opening adjacent sub-routes (split ranges) and advancing them through a small-stateful probe and KV warm-up phase before moving traffic further.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline can perform a zipper-style deployment end-to-end in staging with synthetic workloads (50k tokens/min) without manual intervention
Rollout policy supports: per-region sequencing, LTS pinning override, and traffic-split step fractions (1%, 5%, 20%, 50%, 100%)
Automated rollback triggers on SLO breach: latency p50 > target by 30% for 3 consecutive minutes OR error rate increase > 2x baseline within a split window
KV cache warm-up probe runs and reports hit-rate; rollout gate will wait for hit-rate >= 70% for the 20% split step
Runbook includes step-by-step remediation and a one-click abort that returns traffic to last healthy variant
End-to-end integration tests and a canary observability dashboard are present with links in the ticket
implementation_plan: Design orchestration state machine: new 'zipper' states (INITIALIZE -> PROBE -> SPLIT_N -> WARMUP -> VERIFY -> PROMOTE)
Add per-region rollout config in control plane (region_order, concurrent_regions, step_delays)
Implement traffic split controller with gradual percentage increments and atomic switch when step passes
Instrument KV cache warm-up probe and add metric 'rollout.kv_warmup_hit_rate'
Integrate automated gates into pipeline: SLO evaluator, health-check probes, and rollback action
Create migration script to convert existing blue/green manifests to zipper-compatible manifests
Document LTS semantics: how pinning affects rollout sequencing and automatic fallback
E2E tests: harness to simulate region-level failures and measure graceful degradation and rollback
rollout_gates: SLO pass: latency and error rate checks against baseline for 5m window
Behavioral smoke: model output sanity check for 1000 sample prompts
KV warm-up: hit-rate threshold at 20% split step
Traffic stability: no >10% variance in tail latency p95 across 2 consecutive intervals
Dependency health: upstream storage and metadata service OK
monitoring_playbook: Alert: zipper.step.failed -> page on P0, auto-run rollback after 2m if unresolved
Alert: region.slo.deviation -> notify SRE and block further region steps
Automatic snapshot of logs and trace IDs at trigger time for forensic analysis
Post-mortem template linked to rollback incidents
comments: 2026-02-11 - Diego Ramos: Initial spike completed. Implemented state machine sketch and validated on local cluster. Observed warm-up takes ~45s for small models and ~120s for 70B models; will need per-model tuning.

2026-02-15 - Maya Chen (PM): Raised concern about marketing LTS semantics. We should make LTS pinning explicit in the API and surface an override in Console to let customers temporarily opt-out of zipper sequencing when they need immediate cutover.

2026-02-18 - Priya Singh (SRE): Ran chaos test in staging — simulated region-level disk pressure during a 20% split. The current drain logic caused transient 503s. Proposed change: extend drain grace by 30s and queue inflight requests to fallback model variant.
2026-02-22 - Diego Ramos: Implemented automated SLO evaluator hook. Config defaults: latency p50 target = runtime-1.22 SLO, error-rate threshold = 2x baseline. Hook is toggleable per-deployment.
2026-02-27 - Design review (Liam Ortega): Console UX needs clear indication of zipper progress and the ability to pause at any split step. Added mockup link in design doc.
2026-03-01 - Security (Aisha Malik): Reviewed KMS interactions for migration script secrets. Stated security_review_required=true and requested key-access audit logs be included in rollout snapshots.

2026-03-04 - Diego Ramos: Ran a dry-run against staging with synthetic traffic. All gates passed except KV warm-up in eu-west-1 due to cold cache; tuned warm-up policy to increase pre-split probe repetitions. Next: run regional sequencing test with 3 concurrent regions and validate rollback timing.
notes: Trade-offs considered: zipper gives fine-grained control and safer incremental progress but increases orchestration complexity compared to classical blue/green; we accept more moving parts to reduce blast radius.

Open question: how to support inter-region affinity when customers pin to an LTS variant that is only on a subset of regions. Proposal: surface per-customer region pinning and show capacity warnings in Console.
Related incident: INC-2025-11-09 (regional cutover failure) motivated safety guard to snapshot deployment state before each step
Operational constraint: rollout step timers must be cancelable with idempotent abort so an operator can safely resume without double-applying traffic splits.
